events.title: CNA Financial (NYSE:CNA) Misses Q1 CY2026 Revenue Estimates
events.body: Insurance provider CNA Financial (NYSE:CNA) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026 as sales only rose 1.1% year on year to $3.68 billion. Its GAAP profit of $0.78 per share was 37.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
